title: Writing a manuscript with citezot
text: use Better BibTeX, keys follow pattern auth.lower + year + shorttitle(1).lower. citezot can generate keys new items pattern: cz_add(..., key = "auto") uses pattern cz_key_format(): citezot.key_format option set , otherwise one Better BibTeX saved Zotero profile, otherwise Better BibTeX’s default. subset formula language supported (auth, year, shorttitle, title, filters, +); anything else error rather different key. Better BibTeX needed: key pin cz_pin_key() give cz_add() works. Words titles follow Better BibTeX’s rules: HTML tags dropped, titles cut first colon sentence end, short function words “” “” skipped, hyphens punctuation removed inside words (early-diverging becomes earlydiverging).
code: item <- list(   itemType = "journalArticle",   title = "On the origin of species by means of natural selection",   date = "1859",   creators = list(list(creatorType = "author", firstName = "Charles", lastName = "Darwin")) )  cz_suggest_key(item, "auth.lower + year + shorttitle(1).lower") #> [1] "darwin1859origin"  # a taken key gets a letter cz_suggest_key(item, "auth.lower + year + shorttitle(1).lower",                existing = "darwin1859origin") #> [1] "darwin1859origina"  # Better BibTeX's own default pattern cz_suggest_key(item, "auth.lower + shorttitle(3,3) + year") #> [1] "darwinOriginSpeciesMeans1859"

what: How it differs from other packages
title: Cite Zotero References in Quarto Documents
text: rbbt built around RStudio, particularly add-inserting citations write. needs Zotero desktop running Better BibTeX plugin. zot general-purpose Zotero client. works lower (direct) level, versioned writes, batch plans, file attachments read-queries local database. c2z imports references Zotero many sources (including DOIs, ISBNs Norwegian Cristin registry), can edit, copy delete items. citezot seeks lightweight (minimal package dependencies), make bibliography maintenance simple (one function call builds bibliography), careful library (every write dry run unless say otherwise, nothing can deleted), work across platforms, even without Zotero running. descriptions based package’s documentation, code.
